question: India ranked 4th in the Global Firepower Index 2025. Which country topped the Global Firepower Index 2025?
solution:
The correct answer is ​**USA**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] __In News__**

__
 
• India has been ranked **4th** on the **Global Firepower Index 2025** with a score of **0.1184**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• The **United States** is ranked **1st** with a score of **0.0744**, followed by **Russia** and **China**, both with a score of **0.0788**.
 
• **India's ranking** has remained the same as in the 2024 index, and the **top 4 countries** have not changed.
 
• **Bhutan** is ranked at the **bottom** of the index at **145th** position.
 
• **Pakistan's ranking** has dropped from **9th** in 2024 to **12th** in 2025.
 
• The **Global Firepower Index** evaluates **military power** based on **conventional capabilities**, not nuclear strength, covering over 60 parameters such as **manpower**, **natural resources**, **finance**, and **geography**.
 
• The ideal score is **0.0000**, indicating perfect military strength, which no country possesses.
 
• **India** was ranked **1st** globally in terms of **population reaching military age annually**.
 
• India was also ranked **2nd** in **population**, **available manpower**, and **vehicles**.
 
• However, India ranked poorly in areas like **oil consumption**, **natural gas consumption**, **coal consumption**, **external borders**, and **external debts**.
 
• India was ranked **145th** in the world for **helicopter carrier strength** and **mine warfare capability** in the sea.
 
• The **Global Firepower Index** is released annually by **Globalfirepower.com** since 2006, comparing **145 countries** based on their **war-making capabilities** across land, sea, and air.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The top **10 countries** in the **Global Firepower Index 2025** are:

 
 
• **United States** - 0.0744
 
• **Russia** - 0.0788
 
• **China** - 0.0788
 
• **India** - 0.1184
 
• **South Korea** - 0.1656
 
• **United Kingdom** - 0.1785
 
• **France** - 0.1878
 
• **Japan** - 0.1839
 
• **Turkey** - 0.1902
 
• **Italy** - 0.2164
